content: We use the baseline reward $\hat{R_t}$ to reduce the variance of the reward, similar to ranzato2015sequence. To elaborate, a linear model is deployed to estimate the baseline reward $\hat{R_t}$ based on $t$-th state $o_t$ for each timestep $t$. The parameters of the linear model are trained by minimizing the mean square loss between $R$ and $\hat{R_t}$:
